blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Returning Transport Secretary Vince Dizon on Tuesday vowed to implement reforms in the Land Transportation Office (LTO), as well as prioritize the commuters’ welfare and road safety to improve the public transportation system. Dizon made this commitment a day after the latest Cabinet revamp where he was reappointed as the Transport secretary while Secretary Giovanni Lopez will take the helm of the Department of Public Works and Highways. Dizon said that he will continue the programs and reforms that were initiated by Lopez in the agency. READ: Dizon, Lopez swap agencies in latest Cabinet revamp “Sabi ng Palace […]...
